comment: It seems like the simplest solution to solve the problem of spread this ski season would be a requirement of vaccination to ride the lifts. Vail is insisting on proof of vaccination to eat in on mountain restaurants and appears to be leaning in the direction of not masking people in lift lines and planning on loading lifts at capacity. Proof of vaccination could easily be linked to passes and would greatly reduce the risk of spread throughout the season. A recent editorial in the Park Record lauded Park City and Summit County residents with high vaccination rates and if we don’t require this proof of visitors we’re putting residents at risk as well as a safe for all ski season and the local economy as well. Seems like riding up the mountain in a packed gondola with unmasked and unvaccinated occupants would be extremely unsafe and a problem easy to remedy.
source: Email correspondence (published verbatim in council meeting minutes)
